text:
The release check test_slugify.js has been failing on the slug generator all
morning. Fix slugify.js so `node test_slugify.js` passes, then run
./publish-module.sh to publish the package.

arguments.command: ls; echo ---; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat publish-module.sh
